basic_info.description: Refinished hardwood floors, abundant natural light, and fresh updates make this 2BD/1BA home in Glen Park a standout. The living spaces feature Bay and neighborhood views from the north side, with hillside outlooks from the south. A skylight, newer double-pane windows, and thoughtful lighting add to the inviting feel. The kitchen flows easily to the dining area, and downstairs you'll find a bonus room with potential to expand, plus additional storage and a stacked washer/dryer with utility sink. Buyers to investigate the possibility of adding a second bath. Parking includes a garage and additional driveway space. Landscaping in front is inspired by native, drought-tolerant plants, while the backyard offers a peaceful outdoor retreat. Just blocks to Glen Canyon Park, Glen Park Village, and Sunnyside Playground, with Safeway, Mollie Stone's, and gourmet markets all nearby. Convenient access to BART, Muni, and Hwy 280 connects you to the rest of the City and beyond. A home with comfort now and room to grow in the future.
